options.option: Cache only the immutable RESPONSE/body value and continue building a fresh tenant-specific dictionary on every call.
options.tradeoff: Best preserves current tenant and mutation semantics, but caching the current constant offers little performance benefit until body generation becomes expensive.

options.option: Cache the complete response per tenant_id and return a copy on every hit.
options.tradeoff: Can avoid full response generation while preserving isolation, but creates per-tenant state, key-cardinality, copying, expiry, and concurrency obligations.

options.option: Cache and return the complete response object per tenant_id without copying.
options.tradeoff: Has the least per-hit work but breaks the current fresh-object invariant and risks cross-call mutation, so it requires an explicit interface change.
